mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS (user_id, password, email, nickname, phone_number, profile_img, region_address) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{password}, #{email}, #{nickname}, #{phoneNumber}, #{profileImg}, #{regionAddress} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
